description: Proposed ground floor rear extension, first floor upper extension and loft conversion to accommodate for 2 3 bed flats
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-a66794fb-7fff-3f45-1ba6-731dfc720532"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The application fails to provide adequate information to demonstrate how to proposal development would protect and retain trees onsite. In the absence of this information, the Local Planning Authority cannot determine the impact on trees or ensure compliance with policy G7 (Trees and woodland) of the London Plan (2021) and LP51 (Tree Management and Landscaping) of Hackney’s Local Plan 2033 (2020).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-8980889b-7fff-66dc-a0b4-7f971d87cf51"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The application fails to provide adequate information to demonstrate how the proposed development would deliver measurable Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) or be exempt from the requirements, contrary to the requirements set out in the Environment Act 2021. In the absence of this information, the Local Planning Authority cannot determine the impact on local biodiversity or ensure compliance with Policy LP47 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (LP33), and Paragraph 187 of the National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b183dba3-7fff-7c0f-0278-0fad114a237d"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed rear extension, by reason of its height, scale and siting, would give rise to adverse impacts to neighbours, contrary to Policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020), Policies D3 (Optimising Site Potential Through a Design Led Approach) and D6 (Housing Quality and Standards) of the London Plan (2021) and the Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document 2009.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-24a8d457-7fff-ad13-9f59-fc249f6c5b3e"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed development, namely in respect to the ground floor bedrooms, would fail to provide a high quality standard of accommodation for its occupants to the detriment of the living conditions of future residents. The development proposal falls contrary to policies LP2 (Development and Amenity) and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033, policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design led approach) and D6 (Housing Quality and Standards) of the London Plan 2021 and Residential Extension and Alterations SPD 2009.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-06bf936a-7fff-c35f-802e-578df499e397"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The cumulative proposed extensions, by reason of their positions, scale, detailed design, and bulk, would result in incongruous, discordant and uncharacteristic addition that fails to respect the character and appearance of the host dwellings and the wider terrace. As such the proposal is contrary to policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach) and D4 (Delivering good design) of the London Plan (2021) and policy LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and the guidance contained within Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).&nbsp;</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-20b006af-7fff-ec53-701a-99fd5cd70998"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed roof terrace, by reason of its increased depth and location, would harmfully&nbsp; exacerbate levels of overlooking and loss of privacy to neighbouring residents, contrary to Policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020), Policy D3 (Optimising Site Potential Through a Design Led Approach) and D6 (Housing Quality and Standards) of the London Plan (2021) and the Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document 2009.</span></p>
